items.title: Resolve Codex adapter verify command from available wrappers
items.context: Update codex-adapter evidence summaries and REVIEW preflight rendering so missing/failing/stale evidence recommends an existing local command: lattice-codex when present, otherwise koala-codex, lattice.js, koala.js, or documented global-thin fallback. Must cover legacy wrapper-only and lattice wrapper cases.
items.userSees: When Codex adapter evidence is missing, failing, or stale, REVIEW/DONE preflight prints a verify_codex command that exists in the current repository instead of a missing lattice-codex wrapper.

items.title: Make worktree acceptance guidance prefer current worktree CLI
items.context: Strengthen runtime/preflight/docs guidance so story worktree acceptance points to node bin/lattice.js or node packages/main/dist/cli.js for current code, and labels bare global lattice as heartbeat/post-merge main fallback when it may lag the worktree.
items.userSees: A developer in a story worktree sees guidance that uses the current worktree local CLI for status/validate/gate evidence and labels stale global lattice as advisory fallback only.

items.title: Add focused regression tests and delivery evidence
items.context: Add smoke/unit coverage for both resolver behavior and stale-global guidance, then run the focused Lattice CLI validation set without reintroducing Swift/Mac Native App validation.
items.userSees: The story delivers focused smoke/test commands whose output proves the resolver and worktree guidance behavior without using Swift or Mac Native App validation.
